test_mean_squared_error: test the mean_squared_error function to compute MSE between true and predicted regression values
test_r2_score: test the r2_score function to compute the coefficient of determination for regression models
test_mean_absolute_error: test the mean_absolute_error function to compute MAE between true and predicted regression values
test_mean_pinball_loss: test the mean_pinball_loss function to compute quantile-based pinball loss with configurable alpha
test_mean_tweedie_deviance: test the mean_tweedie_deviance function to compute Tweedie deviance for various power parameters
